contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP TETRICVS [?PF] AVG ; R/ SALVS AVGG

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Tetricus I (271-274), Cunetio no. 2617. Obverse description: Radiate bust draped and cuirassed right, bearded. Obverse inscription: IMP TETRICVS [?PF] AVG. Reverse description: Salus standing left extending patera to feed snake. Reverse inscription: SALVS AVGG. Diameter: 19.2mm, Weight: 3.16gms, die axis: 12
